script_line: That is why she came down backwards. Backwards takes the catch out.

risks.risk: she turns and walks down forwards
risks.prevented_by: facing the stairs, one step backwards; no turning round, no walking forwards

risks.risk: a foot melts into the step
risks.prevented_by: one step at a slow countable pace; NEG-WARP-C; no feet sliding
RIG-R1C: the phone stays at the foot, sways but never travels
